text:
jamie: Heads up — canary rollout for inference-service v2 is showing crashloops after today's deploy. Noticing ↑ OOMs and failing readiness probes. Paging oncall.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: canary=inference-v2 in cluster/prod — CrashLoopBackOff (5 pods) — Priority: P1 — Pager: @eva — link: https://pager.example/incident/4811122222 :rotating_light:

eva: I'm on it, pulling logs now. Any customer reports?

jamie: prod-support says some customer requests 502ing, ~4% error rate for inference endpoints in eu-west-1. No broad API outage yet.

sarah: grabbing `kubectl get pods -n prod -l release=inference-v2 -o wide` output

sarah: ```
NAME                                        READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
inference-v2-canary-5f9d7f6b7-ptx9c         0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   6          4m
inference-v2-canary-5f9d7f6b7-bk2qz         0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   5          3m
inference-v2-canary-5f9d7f6b7-rc1vd         1/1     Running            0          2m
```

jamie: logs show process OOM then docker restart loop. snippet from container log:

jamie: ```
2026-03-17T03:05:12.123Z ERROR runtime: out of memory
2026-03-17T03:05:12.124Z FATAL runtime: signal: killed
```

tomas: HPA scaled up to 10 during the spike but nodes are getting evicted due to a node-drain that happened during deploy window. suspect combined effects: new image has higher memory footprint + drain trimmed capacity -> OOMs.

eva: Good catch. Any manifest changes to memory requests/limits?

jamie: The v2 manifest mistakenly lowered `resources.requests.memory` to 1Gi for canary (should be 4Gi). Looks like a bad diff in the deployment YAML.

prod-support: customer-impact update: several mid-size customers saw increased latency and occasional 5xxs for streaming endpoints. No data loss reported. Estimated affected requests: ~2.1k/min for the region at peak.

ops-lead: We need immediate mitigation: (1) stop sending traffic to canary, (2) revert or scale canary down, (3) if rollback needed, perform. I'll take action unless someone objects.

eva: I can toggle the feature flag to stop routing to v2 canary. Flag key `routing.inference_v2_ratio`. Setting to 0.

eva: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggles -d '{"key":"routing.inference_v2_ratio","value":0}'` -> 200 OK :white_check_mark:

jamie: Traffic diverted. Error rate dropping from 4% -> 0.3% in 2m. Good.

sarah: Meanwhile I'll patch the manifest to correct memory requests and bump image if needed. Propose updating canary resources.requests.memory back to 4Gi and reapply as a hotfix.

tomas: Note: node drain left some pods in Terminating; signal handling in preStop blocks termination for 30s causing extra pressure. We should remove the blocking preStop sleep in v2 image.

ops-lead: Agreed. Plan: 1) keep flag off, 2) scale canary to 0 replicas, 3) roll back deployment to v1 stable for canary label if any traffic leakage, 4) open a PR for manifest fix and test in staging. I'll run rollback now.

ops-lead: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-v2-canary --replicas=0` -> scaled

ops-lead: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=11` (undo to v1 stable)

jamie: Rollback initiated. Monitoring metrics. Suggestions for postmortem: root cause = bad diff to memory requests + node drain that reduced usable capacity + preStop blocking amplifying pod termination time.

prod-support: Notifying affected customers with a short status: "We've rolled back a canary deploy that caused transient errors for inference. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with remediation ETA."

eva: Oncall handoff note: I'm taking this incident for the next 30m to validate rollback stabilized infra and confirm customers are healthy.

oncall-bot: ONCALL HANDOFF: @eva now oncall for incident 4811122222 — handoff message saved.

jamie: Quick patch PR created: `fix(inference): restore memory requests to 4Gi and remove preStop sleep` -> PR #4221. CI green on staging.

sarah: After rollback, error rate back to baseline ~0.1. No more crashloops seen.

ops-lead: Keeping incident open until rollout fixes merged and canary re-run in staging. Also recommend we add a CI check to prevent downward mem-request diffs for canaries.

prod-support: Customer follow-up scheduled in 2 hours.

tomas: For the followup, include mitigation timeline + exact pod counts and affected requests. Also include the flag toggle time and rollback time.

eva: I'll assemble notes and start the incident ticket with timeline, participants, and action items.

jamie: Thanks all. Final status update: rollback complete, traffic diverted, root cause identified, PR opened, handoff to eva. Keeping incident P1 until postmortem posted. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Incident 4811122222 status=mitigated by rollback — P1 -> monitoring. Link: https://pager.example/incident/4811122222

ops-lead: After postmortem we should add a deployment gate: if node drain active OR cluster under eviction, block canary rollouts. Filing infra ticket.

prod-support: Resolving customer-facing page when PR merged and canary re-tested.

eva: Ending handoff: will update last_message_ts after postmortem doc created.
